SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.olist_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered') AS delivered_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS joined_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.order_id IS NULL THEN o.order_id END) AS orders_without_payment,
    COUNT(*) AS joined_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.customer_city IS NULL THEN o.order_id END) AS missing_city,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM main.olist_customers) AS duplicate_customer_ids
FROM main.olist_orders AS o
LEFT JOIN main.olist_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN main.olist_order_payments AS p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'

WITH lowest_five_cities AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_city,
        SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_payments,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS delivered_order_count
    FROM main.olist_orders AS o
    JOIN main.olist_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN main.olist_order_payments AS p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.customer_city
    ORDER BY total_payments ASC, c.customer_city ASC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT
    AVG(total_payments) AS average_total_payments,
    AVG(delivered_order_count) AS average_delivered_order_count
FROM lowest_five_cities
LIMIT 1
